A stranger was kind enough to help me assemble a parts list for my first gaming PC. I'm looking for something that'll cost ~$1,000; monitor, keyboard, and all. I want it to run current-gen games on medium to high settings, and plan to dual-boot Windows 7 and SteamOS/Ubuntu. I've opted for no WiFi adapter or heatsink to save money, and am going for a cheap mouse/keyboard combo. I can supply any other information necessary. Here is the list, and here is the monitor. Thank you for any opinions!
Someone helped me assemble a parts list, and wanted a second opinion.

1. You don't need a WD black HDD unless you are doing something similar to server work. A blue would work just fine and even seagate 1TB is acceptable

  2. The motherboard is ok. The only change is really the usb type c support.

  3. Get a better power supply. The EVGA G2 is one that I definitely recommend.

  4. A locked CPU? are you going to overclock?

My opinion is that you should get something even cheaper (amazon basics maybe?) as a mouse and keyboard and then save up until you can afford a good mechanical keyboard and a good mouse.
